visualCharacteristics: A row of bordered jump buttons with arrows that link to sections on the same page. Variants render numbered tabs, two-up grids, or icon cards with a chevron.
contentPattern: One row per link: a single cell with a link paragraph (usually to #anchor); with icons, two cells per row: [icon picture][link paragraph].
usage: Use it for in-page navigation buttons that jump to sections further down the page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for any list of anchor or related-page buttons; pick columns or cards when items carry body text.
